response.answer: On HarborMesh issue 37, the correction says Mira Solen (@mira-estuary, person:841) proposed the change: retain the original event timestamp plus a local monotonic sequence, and compare orders after reconnect. The issue comment evidence shows it was created 2024-06-18T14:20:00Z as a proposal with no implementation. Leto Neri did not propose it; Leto only reviewed the parser. The earlier memory entry claiming Leto Neri proposed receipt-time ordering and that it was adopted June 18 was incorrect, and June 21 was when that incorrect entry was written, not when Mira was met. The proposal was not adopted as of the correction and still had not been adopted.
